test_boundary.kind: local trace-only emulator-generated track-0 audio-profile record

native_initialization_proof.invocation: local guest-RAM call trampoline after the stock Sample Slot setter and before the track trigger
native_initialization_proof.result: PASS: the untouched native initializer copied the complete 56-byte source record into the persistent voice table.

post_trigger_profile_service.track0_voice0_eligibility: recomputed from the live timeline; observed as both 0x00 and 0xFF across trace runs
post_trigger_profile_service.conclusion: The persistent descriptor is structurally accepted, but it is not the post-trigger promotion source. The live scheduler may mark it eligible, after which the queued-trigger path can retire the pre-existing record before the primary writer. The stock pad trigger still correctly enters through the transient 0x42AC4038 record.

packed_consumer_result.interpretation: The packed result remains unchanged. This experiment rules out preloading the persistent project/audio-profile descriptor as the correct way to supply timing and seed values for a live pad trigger.

next_step.name: AR172_QEMU_TRANSIENT_TRIGGER_SMOOTHER_GATE
next_step.objective: Trace how the stock parameter class determines event bit 5 and the timing/seed scalars for transient record 0x42AC4038, verify whether Sample Slot is intentionally immediate or smoothed, and identify the correct packed-byte extraction contract before adding any emulator state.
